title: Katie Zacharia Denies Involvement With AI Mining Startup
excerpt: Former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia was listed as an adviser to an AI mining startup, but both sides deny any work took place.
body_html:
Former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia was recently listed as an adviser for a startup focused on using artificial intelligence for rare-earths mining. The company has ties to Kristi Noem.

Despite being listed in connection with the venture, both Zacharia and the startup have stated that she never actually worked there. The brief existence of the startup and the disputed advisory role have drawn attention to the unusual situation surrounding the AI mining venture.
